[attribute-xmlns-mml]
=== `@xmlns:mml` MathML Namespace Declaration

This is not an attribute, but the namespace pseudo-attribute. The value provides a prefix and URI to use for the MathML elements. All namespace prefixes must be associated with a URL, and the prefix “`mml`” has been set to the URL for the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) MathML Tag Set.

#### FIXED (not settable) on many elements; click for list and usage

<<element-adoption,`<adoption>`>>, <<element-app,`<app>`>>, <<element-app-group,`<app-group>`>>, <<element-mml-math,`<mml:math>`>>, <<element-standard,`<standard>`>>
|===
| Value| Meaning

| http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML| The prefix “`mml`” has been set to the URL for the W3C MathML Tag Set.
| Restriction| This attribute has a fixed value which may not be changed in the XML document.
|===
